definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 splits 'character' into four senses (4.26 a code value of a coded character set, 4.27 a graphic character in a screen item, 4.28 a COBOL character, 4.29 a single code value in storage); 2023 drops those entries but keeps each sense under its own term (§2023:3.7 alphanumeric character, national character, §2023:3.93 graphic character, §2023:3.37 COBOL character repertoire), so the drop is of a heading, not of a meaning. Character positions of usage national are the storage unit (4.31), as in 2023; no change of scope.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:8.8.1.1/8.8.1.3.1/8.8.1.3.6 (standard arithmetic, 32-digit standard intermediate) bear on a function only through §2002:15.3.1 (numeric and integer function results under standard arithmetic); NATIONAL-OF is national, so they do not apply. §2002:15 is 2023's 15.1 word for word and §2002:15.1 (types of functions) differs from §2023:15.2 only by its sentence that the number of character positions is specified in the function definition (2023 admits dynamic lengths); RV4 is exactly the function definition's length statement that §2002:15.1 points to, so the 2002 sentence is satisfied by this very rule.
